We raised $3M to build Lucius AI - the Context Layer for Your Organization. Backed by Future Capital Discovery Fund, we’re tackling a problem we kept running into ourselves:

Individuals ship 10× faster with AI. Organizations don't.

Over 30% of your team's time is spent rebuilding context someone already had. It shows up everywhere a decision was already made but can't be found again - community operations, customer support, pre-sales reception, sales research, project management, internal collaboration.

We're building Lucius to close that gap.
